   Item No. 1

  MINUTES
  CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  TRANSPORTATION COMMISSION
  Regular Meeting of May 8, 2024

Call to Order

Roll Call:  The May 8, 2024 meeting of the Transportation Commission

Present:  Steven Placido, Henry Aviles, Cliff Bender, Monica Calderon, Elliott
  Lee, Lilian De Loza Gutierrez, Omar Galicia

Absent:  Antonio Chavira Jr, Gwen Chen, Albert Lu

Also in attendance, Traffic Engineer Jana Robbins, Public Works Deputy Director
Melissa Ramos and Commission Secretary Dennis Ahlen.

PRESENTATIONS

1.  APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES OF NOVEMBER 8, 2023

It was moved by Commissioner Bender, seconded by Commissioner Calderon, and
carried unanimously, to approve the minutes of November 8. 2023.

2.  APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES OF JANUARY 24, 2024.

It was moved by Commissioner Galicia, seconded by Commissioner Bender, and carried
unanimously, to approve the minutes of January 24, 2024.

3.  ALL WAY STOP REQUEST AT ALHAMBRA ROAD AND PRIMROSE AVENUE

Traffic Engineer Jana Robbins reviewed with the Commission the traffic
engineering safety report assessing the intersection of Alhambra Road and
Primrose Avenue.

After a thorough review of existing field and traffic conditions and per the
California Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices (CAMUTCD), California
Vehicle Code (CVC), based on the traffic review and engineering judgement, it
was determined that Alhambra Road at Primrose Avenue does not qualify for
all way stop at the intersection. However, the intersection would benefit from the
installation of other traffic calming improvements.

After discussion, an additional 5’ of red curb was requested for a total of 20 feet
on the approach of the southwest corner on Alhambra Road. It was moved by
Page 1 of 3
 Commissioner De Loza Gutierrez and seconded by Commissioner Bender, and
carried unanimously, to adopt the recommended improvements.

4. TRAFFIC REVIEW ON NORTH ELECTRIC AVENUE BETWEEN LARCH AVENUE
AND WEST MAIN STREET

Traffic Engineer Jana Robbins reviewed with the Commission the traffic
engineering safety report assessing North Electric Avenue between Larch Ave and
West Main Street.

After a thorough review of existing field and traffic conditions and per the
California Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices (CAMUTCD), California
Vehicle Code (CVC), based on the traffic review and engineering judgement, it
was determined that the intersection of North Electric Avenue at Larch Street
does not meet minimum volume or collision thresholds for installation of all-way
stop control. The segment of North Electric Avenue between Larch Street and
West Main Street does not qualify for the installation of speed humps as the City
does not have a speed hump policy in place. However, this segment could be
improved with the installation of other traffic calming improvements.

After discussion, it was moved by Commissioner Bender, seconded by
Commissioner Lee, and carried unanimously, to adopt the recommended
improvements.

5. RED CURB REQUEST AT THE INTERSECTION OF FRONT STREET AND CURTIS
LANE

Traffic Engineer Jana Robbins reviewed with the Commission the traffic
engineering safety report assessing the request for red curb at the intersection of
Front Street and Curtis Lane.

After a thorough review of existing field and traffic conditions, and based on
engineering judgement, it was determined that additional red curb is
recommended to be installed at the intersection of Front Street and Curtis Lane.
Adding red curb will remove 1 parking space on each side of Curtis Lane. This
enhancement will provide an adequate line of sight for vehicles turning right or
left from Curtis Lane into Front Street, to see oncoming and approaching traffic
along Front Street.

After discussion, it was moved by Commissioner Bender, seconded by
Commissioner De Loza Gutierrez. Commissioners Aviles, Bender, Calderon, De
Loza Gutierrez, Galicia, Placido voted Aye, zero Nay. Commissioner Lee
abstained from voting. The motion passed.

6.  PUBLIC COMMENTS

None

 7.  COMMENTS AND CONCERNS FROM COMMISSION MEMBERS
AND/OR STAFF.

Commissioner Lee introduced himself and his wife to the group and discussed his
background.

Commissioner Bender inquired about the speed limit on Front Street and the
process of setting the speed limit.

Commissioner Galicia requested additional information for implementing traffic
control devices.

Commissioner Bender inquired if anyone has made a formal request for a traffic
study at Main Street and Cordova Avenue.

Commissioner Aviles inquired if there were plans to install a stop sign at the
intersection of Monterey Avenue and Bay State Avenue.

8.  ADJOURNMENT

Commissioner Placido adjourned the meeting to the next regular meeting of the
Alhambra Transportation Commission Adjournment, Wednesday, July 10, 2024 at
6:00 p.m.
